input.quote: This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County (28.2) is our preferred position. There is no arbitration clause; Section 28.3 is only a pre-filing executive escalation that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings. No redline.

input.quote: Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Fully meets the preferred position: Customer has a consent-free affiliate/successor carve-out (24.1); Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance or transfer by change of control without our consent and never to a competitor (24.2); and 24.4 bars any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate or reduce service on our change of control. Section 24.3 applies only to "other assignments" and therefore does not cut back 24.1. No redline.

input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: Direction of ownership runs our way: we own Customer Data and our pre-existing IP with no transfer to Vendor beyond a service-provision processing right (14.1); Vendor assigns Deliverables (14.2); Vendor keeps only its pre-existing Vendor Technology with the perpetual 13.2 licence back for embedded Vendor Technology (14.3); joint ownership is excluded and feedback use is limited (14.4); and 15.1 bars model training on Customer Data without our consent. No redline.

input.quote: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
input.rationale: This is our walk-away position on both counts: the subscription licence is revocable at Vendor's discretion and expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them. It also contradicts 13.2 (which covers Affiliates and contractors for paid-up/embedded material) and 13.3 (transfer rights and revocation only for uncured material breach). Redlined to extend the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and to tie revocation and transfer to 13.3.
